description.text: Build a **high-performance landing page** with **React/Next.js** and **TypeScript** for **instant loading**.

briefDescription.text: Im Abdul, Senior Frontend Developer and Founder & CEO of Dev8X, with 6+ years of experience delivering US-quality engineering solutions. I build blazing-fast, high-converting websites that look stunning and perform flawlessly.  Whether you need a sleek Carrd landing page, a pixel-perfect Figma to Webflow conversion, or a powerful full-scale booking website, I can bring your vision to life.  What I Offer:  Carrd & Webflow Development Fully responsive, mobile-first builds with smooth micro-interactions using GSAP, ScrollTrigger, and Framer Motion.  Advanced Booking Systems Enterprise-grade scheduling platforms. Previously built a real-time booking UI used by 15,000+ active patients, increasing re-appointments by 33% (1,000+ monthly). Also developed a ticket reservation system with live seat availability.  Custom Integrations CRM modules, live video appointments (Agora), and third-party tool integrations.  Why Choose Me?  Proven Results Reduced load times by 40% and boosted engagement by 30%.  Scalable Solutions Expertise in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js.  End-to-End Ownership Product-focused, fast delivery, clean execution.  Lets build something exceptional. Message me to get started

fields.text: Can you convert my complex Figma design into Webflow or Carrd?
Yes! I provide pixel-perfect conversions. I also specialize in adding advanced visual polish like GSAP animations, SmoothScroller, and custom dynamic motion paths to make your design stand out.
What kind of Booking Websites can you build?

I can build everything from simple consultation schedulers to highly complex booking platforms. For example, I built a custom healthcare scheduler that allowed patients to pick locations via Mapbox GL, select times, and securely process millions of dollars in payments.
Can you integrate a CRM or third-party tools into my booking site?

Absolutely. I have extensive experience connecting frontends with backend systems and APIs. I have previously replaced legacy systems (like DentrixAscend) with custom-built CRM dashboards featuring live appointment updates.
What if my project eventually needs to scale beyond Carrd or Webflow?

You are in safe hands! I run Dev8X and have architected large-scale platforms using Next.js, Redux, Node.js, and microservices. If you ever need to migrate to a fully custom web application, I can manage that transition smoothly.
Do you ensure the website is fast and mobile-friendly?

Always. Performance optimization is a core part of my workflow. I use responsive design principles (TailwindCSS, HTML5) and optimization techniques like ImagesLoaded and polyfills to ensure your site loads instantly on any device.
